responsibility: This header customizes the m68k port for embedded targets that do not follow the SVR4 ABI defaults. It changes fundamental ABI choices such as size_t and ptrdiff_t types, bitfield handling, small-structure return policy, function-value register rules, target OS predefines, library selection, and startup-file behavior. Its role is to provide the embedded-system ABI/profile layer on top of the generic m68k backend, especially for linker-script-driven environments without standard host startup files.
